stem:
Complete the following chart.

| Asexual reproduction | Sexual reproduction |
|---|---|
| 1. Reproduction that occurs with the help of somatic cells is called as asexual reproduction. | 1. ………………………………………… |
| 2. ………………………………………… | 2. Male and female parent are necessary for sexual reproduction. |
| 3. This reproduction occurs with the help of mitosis only. | 3. ………………………………………… |
| 4. ………………………………………… | 4. New individual formed by this method is genetically different from parents. |
| 5. Asexual reproduction occurs in different individuals by various methods like binary fission, multiple fission, budding, fragmentation, regeneration, vegetative propagation, spore production, etc. | 5. ………………………………………… |
note: The printed chart is a two-column comparison with five numbered rows per column; rows 2 and 4 are blank on the asexual side and rows 1, 3 and 5 are blank on the sexual side, so the two columns interlock and each blank is the mirror of the filled entry facing it. The blanks are printed as dot leaders and are transcribed as ellipsis runs. 'somatic cells' appears ONLY here — the chapter body never uses the word, defining asexual reproduction instead as occurring 'without involvement of gametes' and being 'uniparental'.

Complete the paragraph with the help of words given in the bracket.

(Luteinizing hormone, endometrium of uterus, follicle stimulating hormone, estrogen, progesterone, corpus luteum)

Growth of follicles present in the ovary occurs under the effect of ----- This follicle secretes estrogen. -- --- - -- -- -- -- grows / regenerates under the effect of estrogen. Under the effect of --- ---, fully grown up follicle bursts, ovulation occurs and -- --- -- -- is formed from remaining part of follicle. It secrets --- --- -- -- and --- --- -- -- --. Under the effect of these hormones, glands of -- -- -- -- are activated and it becomes ready for implantation.
note: There are SEVEN blanks but only SIX words in the bracket, because 'endometrium of uterus' is required twice (once as the tissue that regenerates, once as the tissue whose glands are activated). The book prints 'It secrets' for 'It secretes', and prints no full stop after the first blank ('under the effect of ----- This follicle'). Both transcribed as printed.
